scope_notes: The nested Zope-db CodeQL database directory sits at the repository root (Zope_vuln/Zope-db), NOT under src/, so the structural src/% scope guard in both extraction queries excludes it from code traversal, search and candidate extraction regardless of DB scope; repo-root files (setup.py, util.py, reports, CSVs) are excluded the same way.

src/Testing/ (makerequest, ZopeTestCase, sandbox, ZODButil) is Zope's own test scaffolding package and is excluded per the Augur noise policy (tests and fixtures), as are all */tests/ directories and test_*.py files. Files named interfaces.py (zope.interface declaration stubs with no executable logic) are excluded so interface method declarations are not mistaken for entry points.

Per experiment-independence rules, repository-root artifacts that look like ground truth or prior analysis output (VULNERABILITY_AUDIT_REPORT.md, ZOPE-CVE-REPORT.md, path_traversal_sinks.csv, _verify_checkvalidid.py) were NOT read; all findings below derive only from src/ code.

Dependencies (ZODB, AccessControl, Acquisition, DocumentTemplate, zope.browserresource, zope.publisher, zope.contenttype, zExceptions, Products.ExternalMethod as a separate distribution, waitress) are NOT in the DB; their APIs are matched syntactically by call-site name with module hints.

security_evidence.percent_decoding: WSGIPublisher.py:312-338 re-encodes PATH_INFO latin-1->utf-8 per PEP 3333 (percent-decoding itself happens in the WSGI server, not in this repo); HTTPRequest.py:271 unquote in physicalPathFromURL; :1721-1745 cookie unquote; BaseRequest.py:47-49 quote of traversal steps
security_evidence.symlinks: no symlink resolution/checks on request-derived paths (only module-level realpath of fixed prefixes: App/ImageFile.py:32, App/special_dtml.py:40, App/FindHomes.py:23-25)
security_evidence.prefix_validation: App/Extensions.py:47-54 ValueError when the join collapses below the home (prefix must be relative, name must be simple); OFS/ObjectManager.py:643-651 existence must match within one of the fixed import roots; no prefix/containment check on the joined result in manage_exportObject or DirectoryResource.get
security_evidence.toctou: OFS/ObjectManager.py:645 os.path.exists(filepath) then :679 connection.importFile(filepath) - existence check and open are separate calls (TOCTOU window); Products/PageTemplates/PageTemplateFile.py:160 getmtime then :194 open; Products/Five/browser/resource.py:156-157 isfile/isdir then the external resource object opens the file later in the request

coverage_gaps: Dynamic dispatch / receiver typing: ZODB Connection.importFile (ObjectManager.py:679), zope.browserresource File/FileResource (resource.py:170 factory call resolved through the resource_factories dict), DocumentTemplate.HTMLFile file reading (special_dtml.py:72 delegates via ClassicHTMLFile.inheritedAttribute('__init__')), and zope.contenttype.guess_content_type are external dependencies not present in the DB; they are matched syntactically by call-site name with module hints.

Products.ExternalMethod (the ZMI manage_edit caller of App.Extensions.getObject) is a separate distribution in Zope 5 and not in this repo: getObject's open+exec chain has no in-repo request boundary; kept as candidates with that caveat.

DirectoryResource.get (resource.py:153) is an in-repo override, but the traversal dispatcher that calls get(name) for ++resource++ URLs and any upstream name checks live in the external zope.browserresource/zope.traversing packages; the in-repo override itself performs no '..' or separator filtering before os.path.join/isfile/isdir.

mapply (WSGIPublisher.py:271) marshals request form/query/XML-RPC values into the parameters of EVERY published method; to bound row volume only path/file-relevant parameter names (id, file, filename, name, path, filepath) of manage_* methods are extracted. Other published-method parameters (e.g. manage_renameObject's new_id, OFS.CopySupport ids) are request-controlled too and are a documented gap; CopySupport/Moniker operate on the ZODB object tree rather than the filesystem.

Object-tree traversal (BaseRequest.traverse, OFS.Traversable.unrestrictedTraverse, HTTPRequest.resolve_url) consumes URL segments but resolves ZODB objects, not filesystem paths; only the bridges extracted as sinks convert request data into filesystem paths (ObjectManager import/export, ++resource++ directory lookup, external-method lookup, upload-filename-derived object ids).
get_header/getHeader alias (HTTPRequest.py:1248) and the get_env = environ.get local alias (HTTPRequest.py:323) are matched by name; other rebinding/aliasing of request APIs would be missed.

REQUEST.get(...) returns values from a merged namespace (other/URL/env/common/lazy/form/cookies): some keys are server-provided env only (REMOTE_ADDR, SERVER_PORT) and are not attacker-path-controlled; the family is extracted as one boundary row set and per-key trust is left to labeling.

No archive APIs (zipfile/tarfile/extract/extractall), no pathlib, no io.open, no tempfile and no shutil.rmtree in non-test src code; uploads (OFS.Image/File.manage_upload, webdav PUT) store data in ZODB, never on the filesystem (grep-verified).
App.ApplicationManager/App.DavLockManager/OFS.SimpleItem/OFS.CopySupport contain only ZODB-connection .open() calls, not filesystem opens; Testing/ package excluded as test scaffolding.

Zope2/Startup config loading (zope.conf schema, serve.py plaster-style config, Zope2/App/zcml.py site.zcml) happens at startup from operator-controlled files; only the zconsole/copyzopeskel/mkwsgiinstance/serve CLI open sites are extracted (operator boundary).
The nested Zope-db database directory and repo-root report/CSV artifacts are excluded structurally by the src/% scope guard and were never read during exploration.
